welcome.headline: One workspace for every AI tool you need
welcome.description: Connect multiple providers and freely choose image, video, and audio models. Creation, editing, and workflows live together, while every result and project is saved directly on your device.

features.models: Connect multiple providers and choose models freely
features.canvas: Create, edit, and build canvas workflows in one place
features.local: Keep generated results and projects directly on your device

basics.headline: Choose your data storage location
basics.description: This is the best time to choose a location, while there is little data to move. Pick another folder or keep the default.
basics.dataDescription: Generated results, projects, and related data are stored here. Henji AI creates a Henji-AI folder inside any location you choose.

provider.headline: Choose a default provider
provider.description: New nodes and your first task prefer this platform. Other models remain available, and you can change it at any time.
provider.more: ModelScope, Model Studio, and Volcengine Ark can still be configured under Provider Keys.

kie.description: Broad coverage of new image and video models in one place—good for getting started quickly.

fal.description: A rich first-party model ecosystem with clear endpoints and fine-grained parameters.

apimart.description: A unified API with detailed model metadata for cross-model workflows.

ppio.description: Good regional connectivity for common models and latency-sensitive work, but its supported model selection is currently more limited.

apiKey.headline: Securely save your {{provider}} key
apiKey.description: Electron safeStorage encrypts the key locally. It is never written to projects, regular settings, or logs.
apiKey.configured: A saved key was found on this device. You can test it or replace it.
apiKey.testNote: Connection tests only use read-only balance or model-list endpoints. They never create a generation task or incur model charges.

results.saved_unverified: Saved securely; this provider has no confirmed no-charge verification endpoint
results.invalid_key: Authentication failed. Check whether the key is complete or revoked
results.insufficient_balance: The key is valid, but the balance is insufficient
results.rate_limited: The key is valid, but requests are currently rate-limited
results.timeout: The connection timed out. Check your network and try again
results.network_error: Could not connect. Check your network or proxy settings
results.service_error: The provider returned a service error. Try again later

firstTask.headline: Create your first result in Generate
firstTask.description: We'll open Generate, preselect an image model, and insert an editable prompt. In-app guidance will then show where to choose a model, edit the prompt, and start generation.
firstTask.prompt: A warm bookstore on a rainy night, neon reflected in the window, cinematic composition, delicate lighting
firstTask.notReady: {{provider}} is not configured yet. You can still prepare the task; the app will ask for a key before generation.

coach.modelDescription: Filter models by provider, type, and capability here. An image model from your primary provider is already selected, but you can change it.
coach.promptDescription: The example is ready to use. Keep it or replace it with the image you want to create.
coach.generateDescription: This step calls the model. You can keep using the app after submitting; onboarding completes automatically when the result returns.
coach.successDescription: Next, try another model, add a reference image, or continue the workflow on Canvas.

settings.primaryProviderHint: New nodes prefer this provider. If it has no model for a media type, Henji AI falls back to another available provider.
settings.defaultsDescription: Choose separate default models for images, video, and audio. The same model is matched automatically across providers.
settings.defaultModelHint: This saves the model itself, not a provider-specific endpoint. Leave it unset to let the default provider choose.
settings.defaultsCleared: The new provider does not offer the previous default {{types}} model. The affected defaults were cleared; choose replacements if needed.
settings.description: Reopen the welcome flow. Saved defaults and provider keys are preserved.
